name: Attendance Report
query:
WITH RECURSIVE DateRange AS (
    SELECT %(from_date)s AS attendance_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_ADD(attendance_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    FROM DateRange
    WHERE attendance_date <= %(to_date)s
),

ShiftForDate AS (
    SELECT 
        dr.attendance_date,
        sa.employee,
        st.name AS shift_type,
        st.start_time AS shift_start_time_raw,
        ADDTIME(st.start_time, '00:15:00') AS shift_start_with_buffer
    FROM DateRange dr
    INNER JOIN `tabShift Assignment` sa 
        ON sa.start_date <= dr.attendance_date
       AND (sa.end_date IS NULL OR sa.end_date >= dr.attendance_date)
    LEFT JOIN `tabShift Type` st ON st.name = sa.shift_type
    WHERE sa.creation = (
        SELECT MAX(sa2.creation)
        FROM `tabShift Assignment` sa2
        WHERE sa2.employee = sa.employee
          AND sa2.start_date <= dr.attendance_date
          AND (sa2.end_date IS NULL OR sa2.end_date >= dr.attendance_date)
    )
),

CheckinRecords AS (
    SELECT
        ci.employee,
        DATE(ci.time) AS attendance_date,
        ci.time AS checkin_time,
        ci.log_type
    FROM `tabEmployee Checkin` ci
    WHERE DATE(ci.time) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
      AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR ci.employee = %(employee)s)
),

PairedINOUT AS (
    SELECT
        ci.employee,
        ci.attendance_date,
        ci.checkin_time AS in_time,
        MIN(o.checkin_time) AS out_time
    FROM CheckinRecords ci
    LEFT JOIN CheckinRecords o ON 
        o.employee = ci.employee
        AND o.log_type = 'OUT'
        AND o.checkin_time > ci.checkin_time
        AND o.checkin_time <= DATE_ADD(ci.checkin_time, INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM CheckinRecords i2
            WHERE i2.employee = ci.employee
              AND i2.log_type = 'IN'
              AND i2.checkin_time > ci.checkin_time
              AND i2.checkin_time < o.checkin_time
        )
    WHERE ci.log_type = 'IN'
    GROUP BY ci.employee, ci.checkin_time, ci.attendance_date
),

UnpairedOUT AS (
    SELECT
        o.employee,
        o.attendance_date,
        NULL AS in_time,
        o.checkin_time AS out_time
    FROM CheckinRecords o
    WHERE o.log_type = 'OUT'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM PairedINOUT p
          WHERE p.employee = o.employee AND p.out_time = o.checkin_time
      )
),

CheckinPairs AS (
    SELECT * FROM PairedINOUT
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM UnpairedOUT
),

PresentRecords AS (
    SELECT
        cp.employee AS employee,
        emp.employee_name,
        cp.attendance_date,
        DAYNAME(cp.attendance_date) AS attendance_day,
        sfd.shift_type,
        'Present' AS status,
        cp.in_time,
        cp.out_time,
        ROUND(
            IF(cp.in_time IS NOT NULL AND cp.out_time IS NOT NULL,
               TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, cp.in_time, cp.out_time) / 3600.0,
               0
            ), 3
        ) AS working_hours,
        IF(
            cp.in_time IS NOT NULL 
            AND TIME(cp.in_time) > COALESCE(sfd.shift_start_with_buffer, '09:15:00'),
            1, 
            0
        ) AS late_entry
    FROM CheckinPairs cp
    LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON cp.employee = emp.name
    LEFT JOIN ShiftForDate sfd 
        ON sfd.employee = cp.employee 
       AND sfd.attendance_date = cp.attendance_date
    WHERE cp.in_time IS NOT NULL
),

AbsentRecords AS (
    SELECT
        emp.name AS employee,
        emp.employee_name,
        dr.attendance_date,
        DAYNAME(dr.attendance_date) AS attendance_day,
        sfd.shift_type,
        'Absent' AS status,
        NULL AS in_time,
        NULL AS out_time,
        0 AS working_hours,
        0 AS late_entry
    FROM DateRange dr
    CROSS JOIN `tabEmployee` emp
    LEFT JOIN ShiftForDate sfd 
        ON sfd.employee = emp.name 
       AND sfd.attendance_date = dr.attendance_date
    LEFT JOIN CheckinPairs cp ON 
        emp.name = cp.employee 
        AND cp.attendance_date = dr.attendance_date
    WHERE (%(employee)s IS NULL OR emp.name = %(employee)s)
      AND cp.employee IS NULL
),

AllRecords AS (
    SELECT * FROM PresentRecords
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM AbsentRecords
),

-- Existing grand total for hours
GrandTotalHours AS (
    SELECT
        'Total Hours' AS employee,
        NULL AS employee_name,
        NULL AS attendance_date,
        NULL AS attendance_day,
        NULL AS shift_type,
        NULL AS status,
        NULL AS in_time,
        NULL AS out_time,
        ROUND(SUM(working_hours), 3) AS working_hours,
        NULL AS late_entry
    FROM AllRecords
),

-- New: Count of Present days
PresentCount AS (
    SELECT
        'Total Present Days' AS employee,
        NULL AS employee_name,
        NULL AS attendance_date,
        NULL AS attendance_day,
        NULL AS shift_type,
        'Present' AS status,
        NULL AS in_time,
        NULL AS out_time,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS working_hours,
        NULL AS late_entry
    FROM AllRecords
    WHERE status = 'Present'
),

-- New: Count of Absent days
AbsentCount AS (
    SELECT
        'Total Absent Days' AS employee,
        NULL AS employee_name,
        NULL AS attendance_date,
        NULL AS attendance_day,
        NULL AS shift_type,
        'Absent' AS status,
        NULL AS in_time,
        NULL AS out_time,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS working_hours,
        NULL AS late_entry
    FROM AllRecords
    WHERE status = 'Absent'
)

-- Final output: regular rows + hours total + present count + absent count
SELECT 
    employee,
    employee_name,
    attendance_date,
    attendance_day,
    shift_type,
    status,
    in_time,
    out_time,
    working_hours,
    late_entry
FROM AllRecords

UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM GrandTotalHours
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM PresentCount
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM AbsentCount

ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN employee = 'Total Hours' THEN 2
        WHEN employee = 'Total Present Days' THEN 3
        WHEN employee = 'Total Absent Days' THEN 4
        ELSE 1 
    END,
    employee,
    attendance_date;
